text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
In the latter half of summer training 
camp, I learned that that junior Umamusume 
couldn't enter the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
Apparently, there weren't enough open 
starting gates...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
If I blocked the path of my favorite 
idol... If I hadn't debuted, she would 
have... But Trainer-san reminded me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume-chan turns even frustration into 
tomorrow's strength, overcoming any 
hardship! That's why I love Umamusume-chan 
so much!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
She's sure to overcome it too. That's why 
I can't afford to stumble here...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I'll fight with everything I've got for 
her sake too. And I'll channel the 
feelings of every Umamusume I've raced 
against so far right at Opera O-san and 
Doto-san!
